recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Reintroducing the old paymentAmount/detail names would conflict with FHIR-26601 and the current version mapping, while the requested semantics are already present.
issue_request: FHIR-19497 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core PaymentReconciliation change request, raised and applied for STU3. It asked to rename PaymentReconciliation.total to paymentAmount, add PaymentReconciliation.paymentIdentifier as Identifier 0..1, align detail.submitter reference targets with Claim.provider, and add Practitioner and PractitionerRole to detail.payee targets.
initial_application: Commit f369c813fb explicitly included GF#19497 and updated the then-authoritative PaymentReconciliation spreadsheet/example to use paymentAmount, add paymentIdentifier, and set detail.submitter/detail.payee targets to Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization.
additional_context: PaymentReconciliation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published PaymentReconciliation work in FHIR-26601 intentionally renamed paymentAmount to amount and detail to allocation for the current build; source/fhir.ini preserves mappings from total to paymentAmount and from paymentAmount/detail.* to amount/allocation.*. FHIR-26601 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source has PaymentReconciliation.amount as the total payment amount, PaymentReconciliation.paymentIdentifier as Identifier 0..1, PaymentReconciliation.allocation.submitter with the same Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization targets as Claim.provider, and PaymentReconciliation.allocation.payee with Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization targets.
